Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised enemy character concept board for a historical Sengoku game, 1560-1573.
Input image 1 is the exact edit target. Keep its 5 columns by 2 rows, warm neutral parchment background, full-body painted concept-art technique, clean hands and readable weapons, subtle floor contact shadows, and the same five recognizable human faces/body silhouettes. Each bottom cell is the SAME person and SAME equipment as the top cell, in action. Preserve the layout and role order: column 1 ashigaru, column 2 ranged soldier, column 3 flag bearer, column 4 officer, column 5 distinct human miniboss. No titles, labels, letters, calligraphy, watermarks, new panels or new figures.
Critical changes applying to BOTH ROWS:
Column 1 MUST hold a LONG STRAIGHT two-handed yari. It has a long plain wooden shaft and a compact straight steel spearpoint. Top standing pose holds the same spear with two hands; bottom lunges/thrusts with two hands. Remove any handheld sword, handheld shield, hooked spear, curved naginata or exotic blade from column 1.
Columns 1-3 are ordinary foot soldiers: show plentiful unarmored plain kosode sleeves, loose plain trousers, cloth forearm and lower-leg wraps and straw waraji sandals. Their only armor is a modest worn plain black/brown iron or leather torso breastplate, optionally a FEW SHORT SEPARATED waist plates. Their cloth trousers and thighs remain clearly exposed; remove all ornate full lamellar suits, continuous armored thigh skirts, large shoulder armor, metal arm/leg suits, face masks and gold trim. Their outfits are visibly poorer and lighter than the officer. Cloth colors shared across factions: worn undyed flax, charcoal, dusty brown and muted grey. Former faction color is ONLY sparse sash/cord, not a matching uniform, no repeated crests on clothes.
Vary practical head protection across ranks. Column 1 wears a shallow SMOOTH dark-lacquered iron or leather jingasa with a low crown, visibly NOT woven straw. Column 2 uses a plain headcloth unless the faction-specific instruction below says otherwise. Column 3 uses a simple rounded low iron helmet. Do not give everybody the same hat.
Column 3 carries a tall NARROW VERTICAL nobori: a narrow hanging cloth rectangle, height at least 3 times its width, on an upright long pole, attached along the pole AND to a short horizontal crossbar at its TOP. Preserve this vertical narrow structure even in the windblown action pose. Never a square or wide horizontal flag. Weathered plain cloth with no invented symbols unless specifically instructed below.
Column 4 MUST wear an actual dark iron SUJI-KABUTO: clearly visible raised vertical ribs on a rounded bowl, a modest layered shikoro neck guard and secured chin straps; no plumes, giant decorative horns or fantasy crown. Give the officer midweight dark domaru/haramaki armor with compact shoulders, demonstrably better protected than columns 1-3. Preserve the officer's face, height, command fan and identity.
Column 5 is a human warrior with individual silhouette and their specified weapon, practical helmet, no giant club. Use realistic weapon dimensions.
Keep faces uncovered. Show ALL ten complete figures and weapons with generous margins, no severed/cropped limbs or weapons. Do not let one cell's weapon overlap another figure. Keep the image's wide landscape composition and high-resolution detail.
Faction-specific constraints:
Faction: IMAGAWA circa 1560. Retain blue only in sparse foot-soldier sash/cords; plain faded grey-blue narrow nobori with NO crest. Column 2 remains an archer with a long asymmetric Japanese yumi and arrow/quiver, top at rest, bottom drawing bow. IMPORTANT retain the already accepted officer and miniboss faces, body shapes, clothing character and weapons in columns 4-5, apart from giving column 4 the required ribbed iron suji-kabuto with modest shikoro. Column 5 stays the slender blue-clad naginata lord, same lean face and long slender curved-blade naginata, same helmet silhouette, same upright/action stances. Do not redesign this miniboss.
